Subject: Clarify: ResellCo entity mapping + edge-case SKUs for CPPO activation

Hi Elena / Marketplace Ops team,

Thanks again for working with us on the CPPO for ResellCo. As we prepare the offer activation there are a handful of entity/SKU edge cases in your mapping that I want to clarify before we submit the final private offer. Our legal and finance teams need definitive guidance so the marketplace listing and billing entities match what ResellCo expects.

Top items I noticed in the mapping (see attached spreadsheet):
- Rows 7-9: a bundle SKU (RDC-BNDL-01) that is sold by two separate ResellCo legal entities depending on region — is that meant to be a single invoice line with revenue split, or separate entitlements per entity?
- Row 14: trial SKU that should not be billed but should count toward seat limits for entitlements.
- Row 21: managed-services add-on that ResellCo invoices centrally but wants consumption reported to the local subsidiary for VAT.

Questions for you:
1) For bundled SKUs sold by multiple entities, does ResellCo prefer (A) separate marketplace SKUs per legal entity, or (B) a single SKU with downstream invoice-split?
2) Any constraints on using parent-company invoicing (one entity in EU) for contracts where end-customer VAT must be reported per subsidiary?
3) Confirm whether trial SKUs must be excluded from billing in the CPPO activation metadata (we can set "billable": false).

Goal: finalize mapping and push CPPO request to AWS by 2026-09-24 to meet your internal go-live window. Please see attached: resellco_entity_mapping.xlsx (highlighted rows).

Thanks,

Hi Naomi — thanks for the detailed note and for flagging the rows. I pulled the team for an initial read and added a couple of clarifications inline below.

Quick answers up top:
- Bundles (RDC-BNDL-01): ResellCo prefers option A (separate marketplace SKUs per legal entity) where the purchase is invoiced by a local subsidiary. We can sometimes do invoice-splits but want that as a fallback only.
- VAT/reporting: For managed-services add-ons we require reporting to the local VAT entity — we can share VAT registrations if needed.
- Trial SKUs: Yes, mark "billable": false for the trial SKU; we still want entitlement counts to flow.

I'll attach a cleaned version of the mapping with our suggested entity column filled for the highlighted rows. Can you confirm Redwood's CPPO request can accept multiple SKU rows pointing to different legal entities?

Naomi / Camila — tagging in legal/finance approach. Short summary and recommended path:

1) CPPO SKU metadata: AWS CPPO supports custom SKU attributes in the private offer payload; we can set an attribute "reseller_entity_id" per SKU. That lets us keep a single catalog SKU and attach entity assignment metadata — preferred path.
2) Bundles sold by multiple entities: because ResellCo prefers local invoicing, we should create separate seller-facing SKU instances (SKU-A-EU / SKU-A-UK) only when the product is materially the same but invoiced separately. If ResellCo is fine with metadata-driven routing we avoid duplicate SKUs.
3) Trials: mark billable=false in the CPPO payload; entitlement counters will still be emitted to reporting hook.

Action items:
- Ben: I will draft the CPPO payload template and run it by AWS PS for validation (due 2026-09-20).
- Camila: if we use sku-attribute approach, update listing pipeline to include "reseller_entity_id" and ensure our analytics can join by that attribute (ETA: 3 working days).
- Naomi: confirm final mapping from ResellCo (they said they'd send a cleaned file).

I'll also coordinate DocuSign for the MOU once the final mapping is set — expect signed_mou.pdf to land this week.

Subject: Re: Confirmed approach for ResellCo CPPO activation — next steps

All — confirming the path forward so we have alignment across legal, finance, marketplace ops, and ResellCo: 

- Approach: Use the SKU attribute "reseller_entity_id" in the CPPO payload. That will allow a single catalogue SKU to be associated with one or more ResellCo entities without duplicating the public listing.
- Bundles: For bundles that must be invoiced locally, ResellCo and Redwood will provision a per-entity SKU variant (naming convention: <SKU>-<ENTITYCODE>) as a fallback.
- Trials: Set billable=false and ensure entitlements propagate.
- VAT/Reporting: ResellCo to provide VAT registration numbers for each entity; Redwood finance will accept per-entity VAT reporting for managed add-ons.

Owners & timeline:
- Ben: finalize CPPO payload template and send to AWS PS for validation (due: 2026-09-20).
- Camila: add "reseller_entity_id" to listing upload and analytics pipeline (ETA: 3 business days after Naomi confirms final mapping).
- Naomi: request final cleaned mapping from ResellCo (ETA 24 hours).
- ResellCo: provide VAT registrations and sign MOU (DocuSign link will be circulated).

We will target CPPO submission to AWS on 2026-09-24 and go-live on 2026-09-25, contingent on AWS PS validation and DocuSign completion.

Ben will attach the CPPO payload template and I will attach the signed MOU once returned. Attaching: signed_mou.pdf (placeholder — to be uploaded).
